title: 🔴 Friday the 13th: MSFS 2024 SU5 Beta First Look! Cursed or Fixed?
description:
Is it a lucky day or a cursed one? This Friday the 13th, we’re diving headfirst into the very first beta release of Sim Update 5 (SU5) for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024.

We are putting the beta through its paces to see if the targeted fixes are actually working, or if the bugs are still haunting us.

🕒 STREAM SCHEDULE:
19:00 CET (Central Europe)
18:00 Z (UTC)
1:00 PM EST (US East)
10:00 AM PST (US West)

🔍 THE SU_05 "HIT LIST"
These are the specific items tagged for this update that we are stress-testing live today:
They include:
✅ FPS & VRAM Performance: Investigating the ongoing VRAM bug and performance degradation.
✅ The "Broccoli" Problem: A deep dive into whether photogrammetry trees are still ruining low-altitude flying.
✅ View-Change Stutters: Does switching cameras still cause a massive hitch?
✅ Cessna C408 SkyCourier: Are the condition levers finally bindable?
✅ Missing POIs: Hunting for missing city and town names.

✈️ TODAY'S PLAN:

Live stress tests in heavy scenery areas (NYC/London).
Direct comparisons: SU4 vs. SU5 Beta.
Open Q&A: Taking your requests to test specific aircraft or features live.
